svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="process-view-level-3-help-request" name="process-view-level-3-help-request"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor P as Participant (P1)
 participant M as Web app
 participant GW as API gateway
 participant R as Reports
 participant DB as Reports DB
 participant MQ as RabbitMQ
 participant AI as AI provider (Ollama)
 actor O as Control-room operator (P2)
 Note over P,GW: The user is already logged in with Keycloak; the gateway and Reports both validate the token
 P->>M: Submits help request
 M->>GW: Submit help request [HTTPS/JSON]
 GW->>R: Validate JWT, rate limit (5 per 10 min), forward
 R->>DB: One transaction: save request \"Awaiting triage\" and outbox row
 R-->>M: Request received
 M-->>P: Request received
 loop Every 1 s
 R->>DB: Read pending outbox rows
 R->>MQ: Publish \"help request submitted\", request id only [AMQP]
 R->>DB: Mark outbox row as published
 end
 MQ->>R: Deliver event (at least once)
 R->>DB: Was this message_id processed?
 alt Duplicate
 R->>MQ: Acknowledge and ignore
 else New message
 R->>DB: Read the request by its id
 R->>AI: Ask for triage suggestion [HTTP, timeout, one attempt]
 alt Suggestion in time
 AI-->>R: Category, priority and team
 R->>DB: One transaction: save TriageSuggestion and message_id
 else AI timeout, error, invalid or abstained
 R->>DB: One transaction: fallback, mark request \"Not triaged\", save message_id
 end
 R->>MQ: Acknowledge
 else Processing fails (e.g. database unavailable)
 R->>MQ: Reject, 4 attempts with backoff 1 s, 2 s, 4 s
 MQ->>MQ: Then dead-letter queue: DLQ panel, moved back by hand
 end
 O->>M: Opens the request list
 loop Every few seconds
 M->>GW: Get request list [HTTPS/JSON]
 GW->>R: Validate JWT, forward
 R->>DB: Read requests of this event
 R-->>M: Requests with \"Awaiting triage\", suggestion or \"Not triaged\"
 M-->>O: Shows the list
 end
",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
